notes.title: XingHaiDeLiuYan 1.2.0 version update
notes.content:
The Spring Festival holiday has come to an end. I wonder how everyone spent this holiday? Did you travel to mountains and rivers or enjoy the ice and snow? 

This update brings a new control mode that differs from the basic operation method. In the new mode, you no longer need to hold down the left mouse button to control the movement of the aircraft, but at the same time, you can no longer use the click method to operate the various buttons on the UI interface. Players can press the left Shift key during the battle to switch between the two control modes and find the one that suits them best.

Here are the details of this update:

[list]
[*] A new control mode during battles has been added. Press the left Shift key in the battle interface to switch between the new and old control modes.
[/list]
[list]
[*] The sensitivity of operations after switching in non-battle interfaces has been adjusted to improve the feel of various operations.
[/list]
[list]
[*] The small tips in the level introduction have been adjusted according to the new control mode.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the energy limit could be exceeded when configuring weapons in a few cases.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the resource consumption details in the enhancement interface were not fully displayed when the required quantity was large.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the details below were displayed incorrectly when selecting content that could not be enhanced in the enhancement interface.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where sound effects were lost in the hangar interface in some cases.
[/list]

notes.title: XingHaiDeLiuYan 1.1.2 version update
notes.content:
Dear players, did you have a pleasant New Year?

This update brings a minor change in operation. We hope that players can have a more concise and smooth experience when strengthening weapons and equipment. 

Here are the details of this update:

[list]
[*] The function of directly returning to the previous level by clicking the right mouse button has been added to all interfaces except the battle interface.
[/list]
[list]
[*] A button for opening the resource warehouse has been added to the operation interface of all types of work units in the workshop.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the battle process in level 5-5 would freeze in a few rare cases.
[/list]

notes.title: XingHaiDeLiuYan 1.1.1 version update
notes.content:
This is only a minor update. Here are the details of this update:

[list]
[*] Adjusted the size of some fonts in the UI interface to make them look more coordinated.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Changed the order and content of some of the tips in the level selection screen to better help new players.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed the display error of the Dark Lattice synthesis formula in the workshop interface in some cases.
[/list]

notes.title: XingHaiDeLiuYan 1.1.0 version update
notes.content:
From the result, the time of this update is a little earlier, but it is just a little earlier due to the earlier time, it is not a problem.


Players, the production team is here to give you an early worship in advance, I wish you a happy off-year, happy New Year's Eve, happy Spring Festival!


As announced in the last update, this update officially adds an achievement system to the game. In addition, we adjusted all the background images of all nebula types to generally reduce the brightness of these types of scenes, making them less dazzling than before. We also tweaked the performance effects of a few enemy supercomputers and the sound effects of some weapons.


In addition to the update of the game itself, we have another news to tell you: in order to celebrate the arrival of the Chinese Year of the Snake, XingHaiDeLiuYan will open a special promotion during the New Year, which will be a good opportunity to get the game! If you don't already know this game, you are welcome to add it to your wish list!


Well, that's all for the new news, here are the details of this update:

[list]
[*] Added an achievement system, totaling 10 achievements.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Reduced background brightness for all nebula type levels.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Tweaked the appearance of enemy capital ship Shadow of Generation in level 4-7.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the sound volume of the weapon Space Tear system when configured with the dimensional tear component.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where information was lost when you got Void Spike on your first level 5-6.
[/list]

notes.title: XingHaiDeLiuYan 1.0.1Version update
notes.content:
[b]Players, happy end of the year![/b]


The focus of this update is to add the corresponding name next to almost all the resource ICONS (finally no longer have to guess and have to memorize the abstract lines are what the stuff is), add the help button in most of the scenes to explain the main function of the scene (of course, the level introduction still keeps the tips), And a preview of what resources can be collected before entering the level.


We also made a few minor adjustments to the game graphics, but due to the limited capacity, large-scale adjustments may take a long time to complete. Achievements will take a while to test the various Settings and are expected to be added in the next update.


Here are the details of this update:
[list]
[*] Under the level introduction of the star map scene, the resource acquisition efficiency of the corresponding level has been added.
[/list]
[list]
[*] In the enhanced interface of the hangar scene, the resource name is added next to the resource picture under the resource requirements list.
[/list]
[list]
[*] In the process unit configuration screen of the workshop scene, the resource name is added under the resource picture of all products and formulations.
[/list]
[list]
[*] A functional brief has been added to the configuration interface of the acquisition unit and the simulation unit in the workshop scene.
[/list]
[list]
[*] In the trading interface of the black market scenario, the resource name is added next to the resource image of all paid and acquired items.
[/list]
[list]
[*] In the resource warehouse screen of the Black market scenario, the resource name is added next to the resource image of all known inventory items.
[/list]
[list]
[*] The Help button is added to the upper right corner of the main screen of star map, hangar, workshop, and black market scenes. You can click this button to open the help description screen of the corresponding scene.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Slightly increased the saturation of all scene borders, making them display colors from solid black to dark gray.
[/list]
